title: Horizon and Machine
author: C. M. Galloway
blurb: Hazel Montrose, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
